<!-- Add Font Awesome CDN for icons -->
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.4.2/css/all.min.css">

<style>
  :root {
    --brand-orange: #d94d43;
    --text-light: #ffffff;
    --text-dark: #222222;
    --bg-cream: #f6f4ee;
    --card-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(0,0,0,0.05);
  }

  * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
  html, body { overflow-x: hidden; max-width: 100%; }
  body { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, sans-serif; background: var(--bg-cream); }

  .portfolio-container { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr; min-height: 100vh; }
  @media (min-width: 992px) { .portfolio-container { grid-template-columns: 1.2fr 3.8fr; } }
  .portfolio-container > * { min-width: 0; }

  .profile-sidebar {
    background-color: var(--brand-orange);
    color: var(--text-light);
    padding: 3rem 2rem;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    text-align: center;
  }
  .avatar-frame { width: 160px; height: 160px; border-radius: 50%; overflow: hidden; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; border: 3px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.4); box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.15); }
  .avatar-frame img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; }
  .profile-sidebar h1 { font-size: 2rem; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; color: var(--text-light); line-height: 1.2; }
  .profile-sidebar h4 { font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 400; opacity: 0.9; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; line-height: 1.4; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2); padding-bottom: 1.5rem; width: 100%; }
  .profile-sidebar p { font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; opacity: 0.85; margin-bottom: 2rem; text-align: left; }
  .sidebar-socials { display: flex; gap: 1.5rem; margin-bottom: 2rem; font-size: 1.5rem; }
  .sidebar-socials a { color: var(--text-light); opacity: 0.85; transition: opacity 0.2s, transform 0.2s; }
  .sidebar-socials a:hover { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1.1); }
  .sidebar-skills-title { font-size: 0.9rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1px; margin-bottom: 1rem; opacity: 0.8; width: 100%; text-align: left; font-weight: 600; }
  .sidebar-badges { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.5rem; justify-content: flex-start; width: 100%; }
  .sidebar-badge { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.15); color: var(--text-light); padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 20px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; backdrop-filter: blur(4px); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); }

  .content-showcase { background-color: var(--bg-cream); padding: 4rem 3rem; min-width: 0; }
  @media (max-width: 768px) { .content-showcase { padding: 2rem 1.5rem; } }

  .sidebar-nav { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.75rem; margin-bottom: 2.5rem; padding-bottom: 1.5rem; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.08); }
  .sidebar-nav a { color: #555555; text-decoration: none; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: 30px; background: #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.02); border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.05); transition: all 0.2s ease; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; }
  .sidebar-nav a:hover { color: var(--brand-orange); background: #ffffff; border-color: var(--brand-orange); transform: translateY(-1px); }
  .sidebar-nav a.active { color: #ffffff; background: var(--brand-orange); border-color: var(--brand-orange); font-weight: 600; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(217,77,67,0.25); }

  .back-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem; color: #888; font-size: 13px; text-decoration: none; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; }
  .back-link:hover { color: var(--brand-orange); }

  .thread-header { margin-bottom: 0.5rem; display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 0.6rem; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .thread-header .emoji { font-size: 1.7rem; }
  .thread-header h2 { font-size: 1.7rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-dark); }

  .thread-tags { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.4rem; margin: 0.75rem 0 2.5rem; }
  .thread-tags span { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.06); color: #886a5f; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; padding: 4px 11px; border-radius: 20px; }

  /* ---- The flow: a connected vertical timeline of entries ---- */
  .flow { position: relative; padding-left: 2.6rem; min-width: 0; }
  .flow::before {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    left: 11px;
    top: 10px;
    bottom: 10px;
    width: 2px;
    background: linear-gradient(to bottom, var(--brand-orange), rgba(217,77,67,0.15));
  }

  .thread-empty { color: #888; font-size: 14px; padding: 2rem 0; }

  hr { margin: 2rem 0; border: none; border-top: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.1); }
  
  /* ---- Code + output blocks inside an entry ---- */
  .code-block {
    margin: 0 0 0.9rem;
    border-radius: 10px;
    overflow-x: auto;
    max-width: 100%;
    border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.06);
    font-size: 13px;
    line-height: 1.6;
  }
  .code-block code {
    font-family: 'SFMono-Regular', Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', Menlo, monospace;
    display: block;
    width: max-content;
    min-width: 100%;
  }

  .output-block {
    margin: 0 0 0.9rem;
    border-radius: 10px;
    overflow: hidden;
    max-width: 100%;
    border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
    background: #2b2b2b;
  }
  .output-label {
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.5px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: #bbb;
    background: #222;
    padding: 6px 14px;
  }
  .output-block pre {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 12px 14px;
    overflow-x: auto;
    max-width: 100%;
    color: #e8e8e8;
    font-family: 'SFMono-Regular', Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', Menlo, monospace;
    font-size: 13px;
    line-height: 1.6;
    white-space: pre-wrap;
    word-break: break-word;
  }

  /* ---- Accordion-style collapsible styles ---- */
  .flow-entry {
    position: relative;
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    min-width: 0;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
  }

  .flow-entry .flow-card {
    background: #ffffff;
    border-radius: 14px;
    padding: 0 1.8rem;
    box-shadow: var(--card-shadow);
    border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.03);
    margin-top: 0.5rem;
    max-height: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
    opacity: 0;
    padding: 0 1.8rem;
    min-width: 0;
    overflow-wrap: break-word;
    transform: translateY(-10px);
    transition: all 0.4s ease;
  }

  .flow-entry.expanded .flow-card {
    max-height: 2000px;
    opacity: 1;
    padding: 1.6rem 1.8rem;
    transform: translateY(0);
  }

  .flow-entry .flow-marker {
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: transform 0.2s ease, background 0.3s ease;
    z-index: 10;
    position: absolute;
    left: -2.6rem;
    top: 0.35rem;
    width: 24px;
    height: 24px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--brand-orange);
    color: #fff;
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 700;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px var(--bg-cream);
  }

  .flow-entry .flow-marker:hover {
    transform: scale(1.15);
  }

  .flow-entry.collapsed .flow-marker {
    background: #999;
  }

  .flow-entry.expanded .flow-marker {
    background: var(--brand-orange);
  }

  .flow-entry .flow-header {
    cursor: pointer;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.75rem;
    padding: 0.75rem 0;
    user-select: none;
    border-radius: 8px;
    transition: background 0.2s ease;
  }

  .flow-entry .flow-header:hover {
    background: rgba(217, 77, 67, 0.05);
  }

  .flow-entry .flow-header:hover .flow-date,
  .flow-entry .flow-header:hover h3 {
    color: var(--brand-orange);
  }

  .flow-entry .flow-header h3 {
    margin: 0;
    font-size: 1.05rem;
    transition: color 0.2s;
    flex: 1;
  }

  .flow-entry .flow-header .flow-date {
    font-size: 12px;
    color: #999;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.3px;
    transition: color 0.2s;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  .flow-entry .flow-header .toggle-icon {
    font-size: 14px;
    color: #bbb;
    transition: transform 0.3s ease, color 0.2s ease;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    margin-left: 0.5rem;
  }

  .flow-entry.expanded .flow-header .toggle-icon {
    transform: rotate(180deg);
    color: var(--brand-orange);
  }

  .flow-entry.collapsed .flow-header .toggle-icon {
    transform: rotate(0deg);
    color: #bbb;
  }

  .flow-card p { font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.7; color: #555; margin-bottom: 0.9rem; }
  .flow-card p:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
  .flow-card ul, .flow-card ol { margin: 0 0 0.9rem 1.2rem; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.7; color: #555; }
  .flow-card li { margin-bottom: 0.25rem; }
  .flow-card a { color: var(--brand-orange); }
  .flow-card strong { color: var(--text-dark); }
  .flow-card h1, .flow-card h2, .flow-card h3, .flow-card h4 { color: var(--text-dark); margin: 1.2rem 0 0.6rem; }
  .flow-card > *:first-child { margin-top: 0; }
  .flow-card code:not(pre code) { background: var(--bg-cream); padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 13px; font-family: 'SFMono-Regular', Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', Menlo, monospace; }
  .flow-card blockquote { border-left: 3px solid var(--brand-orange); padding-left: 1rem; margin: 0 0 0.9rem; color: #777; font-style: italic; }

  /* Side-by-side layout - image left, text right */
  .side-by-side {
    display: flex;
    gap: 1.5rem;
    align-items: flex-start;
    margin: 0.5rem 0 1.5rem;
  }
  
  .side-by-side .img-col {
    flex: 0 0 35%;
    max-width: 35%;
  }
  
  .side-by-side .img-col img {
    width: 100%;
    height: auto;
    border-radius: 8px;
    border: 1px solid #eee;
    box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
    display: block;
  }
  
  .side-by-side .text-col {
    flex: 1;
    min-width: 0;
  }
  
  .side-by-side .text-col p {
    margin-top: 0;
  }
  
  .side-by-side .text-col p:last-child {
    margin-bottom: 0;
  }
  
  @media (max-width: 768px) {
    .side-by-side {
      flex-direction: column;
    }
    .side-by-side .img-col {
      flex: 0 0 100%;
      max-width: 100%;
    }
    .side-by-side .img-col img {
      max-width: 100%;
    }
  }
</style>

```{=html}
<script>
(function () {
  function escapeHtml(str) {
    return String(str)
      .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
      .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
      .replace(/>/g, "&gt;");
  }

  function fmtDate(d) {
    const hasTime = /T\d{2}:\d{2}/.test(d);
    const dt = new Date(hasTime ? d : d + "T00:00:00");
    if (isNaN(dt)) return d;
    const dateStr = dt.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { month: "short", day: "numeric", year: "numeric" });
    if (!hasTime) return dateStr;
    const timeStr = dt.toLocaleTimeString(undefined, { hour: "numeric", minute: "2-digit" });
    return `${dateStr} · ${timeStr}`;
  }

  // Markdown renderer with custom image handling
  function renderMarkdown(text) {
    if (window.marked) {
      const renderer = new marked.Renderer();
      
      // Custom image rendering to handle paths correctly
      renderer.image = function(href, title, text) {
        let imgPath = href;
        if (!href.startsWith('http') && !href.startsWith('data:')) {
          if (href.startsWith('/')) {
            imgPath = href;
          } else {
            imgPath = '/' + href;
          }
        }
        return `<img src="${imgPath}" alt="${text || ''}" title="${title || ''}" style="max-width:100%;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #eee;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);">`;
      };
      
      // Preserve HTML in paragraphs
      renderer.paragraph = function(text) {
        if (/<[a-z][\s\S]*>/i.test(text)) {
          return text;
        }
        return `<p>${text}</p>`;
      };
      
      try {
        return marked.parse(String(text), { 
          breaks: true, 
          mangle: false, 
          headerIds: false,
          renderer: renderer
        });
      } catch (e) {
        console.error('Markdown parse error:', e);
        return String(text);
      }
    }
    // Fallback
    return String(text)
      .split(/\n\s*\n/)
      .map((p) => `<p>${escapeHtml(p.trim())}</p>`)
      .join("");
  }

  // After content is in the DOM: turn ```output code blocks into styled result cells,
  // and run syntax highlighting on everything else.
  function postProcessCode(scope) {
    scope.querySelectorAll("pre code").forEach((code) => {
      const pre = code.parentElement;
      if (code.classList.contains("language-output") || code.classList.contains("language-out")) {
        const wrapper = document.createElement("div");
        wrapper.className = "output-block";
        const label = document.createElement("div");
        label.className = "output-label";
        label.textContent = "Output";
        const outPre = document.createElement("pre");
        outPre.textContent = code.textContent;
        wrapper.appendChild(label);
        wrapper.appendChild(outPre);
        pre.replaceWith(wrapper);
      } else {
        pre.classList.add("code-block");
        if (window.hljs) hljs.highlightElement(code);
      }
    });
  }

  // Accordion-style toggle: only one entry expanded at a time
  window.toggleEntry = function(marker) {
    const entry = marker.closest('.flow-entry');
    if (!entry) return;
    
    const isExpanded = entry.classList.contains('expanded');
    
    // Collapse all entries first (accordion behavior)
    document.querySelectorAll('.flow-entry').forEach(el => {
      el.classList.remove('expanded');
      el.classList.add('collapsed');
    });
    
    // If the clicked entry was not expanded, expand it
    if (!isExpanded) {
      entry.classList.remove('collapsed');
      entry.classList.add('expanded');
    }
  };

  const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  const id = params.get("id");
  const container = document.getElementById("thread-content");

  if (!id) {
    container.innerHTML = '<p class="thread-empty">No thread specified. <a href="notes.qmd">Go back to all threads</a>.</p>';
    return;
  }

  fetch("data/threads.json")
    .then((r) => {
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${r.status}`);
      return r.json();
    })
    .then((data) => {
      const thread = (data.threads || []).find((t) => t.id === id);

      if (!thread) {
        container.innerHTML = '<p class="thread-empty">Couldn\'t find that thread. <a href="notes.qmd">Go back to all threads</a>.</p>';
        return;
      }

      document.title = thread.title;

      const tags = (thread.tags || [])
        .map((tag) => `<span>${escapeHtml(tag)}</span>`)
        .join("");

      // Render entries with accordion-style collapsible functionality
      const entries = thread.entries
        .map((e, i) => {
          const renderedContent = renderMarkdown(e.content);
          const isFirst = i === 0; // First entry expanded by default
          
          return `
            <div class="flow-entry ${isFirst ? 'expanded' : 'collapsed'}" data-index="${i}">
              <div class="flow-marker" onclick="toggleEntry(this)">
                ${i + 1}
              </div>
              <div class="flow-header" onclick="toggleEntry(this.closest('.flow-entry').querySelector('.flow-marker'))">
                <span class="flow-date">${fmtDate(e.date)}</span>
                <h3>${escapeHtml(e.heading)}</h3>
                <span class="toggle-icon">▼</span>
              </div>
              <div class="flow-card">
                ${renderedContent}
              </div>
            </div>`;
        })
        .join("");

      container.innerHTML = `
        <div class="thread-header">
          <span class="emoji">${thread.emoji || "🧵"}</span>
          <h2>${escapeHtml(thread.title)}</h2>
        </div>
        <div class="thread-tags">${tags}</div>
        <div class="flow">${entries}</div>
      `;

      postProcessCode(container);
    })
    .catch((err) => {
      console.error('Error:', err);
      container.innerHTML = `<p class="thread-empty">Error loading thread: ${err.message}</p>`;
    });
})();
</script>
```
